basic_info.description: Rare opportunity to own a unique multi-unit property on the corner of three highly coveted neighborhoods in the San Francisco area: Bernal Heights, Mission and Noe Valley Districts! This corner two-unit Edwardian building is perfect for owner-occupiers seeking rental income and/or investors alike. Built in 1908 and owned by the same family for 64 years, these two flats each have decorative fireplaces, wood floors and multiple bonus rooms (for home offices/gym), split baths and 3 independent garage parking spaces plus storage. #5 is 2 bedrooms, 1.5 baths & has been recently updated. #7 is 3 bedrooms, 1 bath. The bonus room off the garage with full bath is legal! Shared laundry room. Easy access to freeways, restaurants and shops. Building faces Northeast and gets drenched in gorgeous southern light from the big windows! Need I say more?
